QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`), and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2196 and 2185).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config header has the threading macros commented out, so a default build defines none of them. That covers THREADING_C and PTHREAD, the two macros the item names.
